# Sortd Money

> Sortd Money is an iPhone spending tracker. Apple Pay taps log themselves through one Shortcuts automation, and receipts can come from Gmail (read-only) or the camera. Data is stored on the iPhone. There is no Sortd server, no account, no ads, no analytics and no trackers. No bank passwords, ever.

- Platform: iPhone, iOS 26 or later
- Price: free to use, including Apple Pay auto-logging. Sortd Pro (Gmail receipts, receipt camera, Insights, subscriptions and bills, category budgets) is monthly, yearly with a free trial for new subscribers, or a one-time purchase.
- Currencies: 30+ currencies, converted at that day's European Central Bank rate.
- Status: beta, via TestFlight.
